exposure: Opportunistic bilateral salpingectomy (OBS) during gynaecological surgery for benign indications
outcome: Proportion of clinicians offering or discussing OBS
Reasons for offering or discussing OBS
cohort: The participants were active Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Obstetrics and Gynaecology (RANZCOG) Fellows in Australia.
finding: The survey found that 70% of respondents offered or discussed opportunistic bilateral salpingectomy (OBS) to women undergoing gynaecological surgery for benign indications, usually at the time of hysterectomy.
cross-section timing: Current practice at the time the survey was conducted (around 2015)
